# @vllnt/next-llms

> Generate an llms.txt file and serve pages as Markdown from Next.js App Router
> route handlers, using Web-standard Request and Response and no dependencies.

`@vllnt/next-llms` is a TypeScript ESM package with two functions.
`generateLlmsText(config)` returns an `llms.txt` index string in the llmstxt.org
shape — an `#` title, a `>` blockquote, optional free prose, `## Section` link
lists (`- [title](url): notes`), and a droppable `## Optional` section.
`createMarkdownRoute(resolver, options?)` returns a Web-standard
`(request) => Promise<Response>` route handler: it drops empty path segments,
strips a trailing lowercase `.md` from the last segment, then URL-decodes each
segment, calls the resolver with the slug, and returns `200` `text/markdown`
with a `Cache-Control` header when the resolver returns a string (an empty
string is content), or `404` `text/plain` when it returns `null` or any other
non-string. A path with malformed percent-encoding, a segment that is empty,
`.` or `..` after stripping `.md` and decoding (such as `/.md` or `/...md`), or
a decoded segment that contains `/`, `\` or NUL gets `400` without calling the
resolver (URL parsing already resolves plain `.` and `..` segments, so
`/docs/../x` gives `["x"]`); in Next.js, malformed percent-encoding gets Next's
own `500` before the handler runs. In Next.js, `HEAD` is answered from `GET`,
`OPTIONS` gets `204` and other methods get `405`. The handler imports nothing
from `next`. Node.js >=18 (CI tests only Node.js 24); no peer or runtime
dependencies.
Successful responses use public caching by default; pass
`cacheControl: "private, no-store"` for private content and check the request in
your own `GET`, because the resolver only receives the slug.

When to use:

- Use it when your Next.js site should serve an `/llms.txt` link index.
- Use it when you have Markdown for your pages and want it at `.md` URLs.
- Do not use it to build the link list from your routes; build it in your code.
- Do not use it to convert HTML to Markdown; use a converter such as `turndown`.
- Do not use it for `llms-full.txt`; concatenate your pages in your own route.

For coding agents: the docs ship in `node_modules/@vllnt/next-llms/` next to
the TypeScript source in `src/` and match the installed version. This file
describes the package itself; it is not output of `generateLlmsText`.
